integrity: Definitions, hypotheses, and the full mathematical argument are stated in RESULT.md. The computation is independently reproducible from verify.py. Bibliographic coverage is best knowledge, with possible unindexed equivalent work.
limitations: Applies to LCM-lattice cardinality for squarefree edge ideals, not general monomial ideals, Betti invariants, random cut ideals or independent polynomial generators. The asymptotic result is theoretical and finite checker results alone do not establish the limit.
title: A four-vertex Poisson law for the LCM density of random edge ideals
